scope: Synchronize existing direct-to-customer TO links after NetSuite SO or TO line refreshes. Manual link creation and yard replenishment retain their existing rules.
acceptance: A refreshed TO with Parkwall 90 PC, newly added Windermere 91.88 SQFT and PALLET 3 EACH updates a stale 6 PC link across its exact sales-order group; operator residuals become zero for the two material lines and three still-unloaded PALLET units.
Refreshing either linked SO lines or TO lines updates coverage, decreases removed quantities, and matches replacement items by current item and unit.
The total linked quantity never exceeds active TO supply or the exact sales target's demand after other allocations and recorded yard loads.
Repeated refreshes are idempotent, concurrent linked-TO refreshes do not duplicate coverage, and duplicate item rows consume each physical TO quantity only once.
Cancelled and replenishment links are untouched; unrelated and unmatched items are never silently assigned.
Historical loads, delivered quantities, receipts, photos, posting commands and external NetSuite transactions remain unchanged; actual allocation changes have before/after audit records.
A failed reconciliation rolls back its allocation and audit changes together. Missing or retired targets produce an explicit result rather than an invented target.

failureModel.overAllocation: Exact fixtures plus randomized conservation properties and integration checks for competing TO/PO supply.
failureModel.wrongSourceLine: Group, duplicate item, changed item and unit mismatch scenarios.
failureModel.historyCorruption: Recorded-progress regression assertions and no external-write ports in the synchronizer.
failureModel.raceOrPartialWrite: Concurrent reconciliation and rollback integration scenarios; shared target advisory lock.
failureModel.silentRefreshFailure: Audit assertions and actual order-sync entry-point integration tests.

setup.git: Preserve all pre-existing workspace edits; no commits or staging.
setup.tests: Use docker-compose.mbt-test.yml with isolated named projects, mbbs-tests.slice budgets, init, bounded tmpfs and disposable-test labels. Register down --volumes --remove-orphans teardown before creation and verify both container lists.
setup.artifacts: Keep logs, source hashes, specification and evidence JSON in server/test-artifacts/linked-direct-ship-sync.

production: Prepare and validate code and a concrete reconciliation preview before any deployment or durable repair.
amendments: User confirmed full matching TO coverage rather than preserving shortage-only allocations.

User requires item lookup because NetSuite line numbers can change. Match current item and unit inside the exact linked target; rekey the existing allocation to its current SO and TO rows without losing recorded history.

The existing database constraint requires positive allocations. Add migration 286 to permit a finite zero requirement so removed source lines retain their recorded history instead of deleting allocation rows. Negative and nonfinite requirements remain rejected.

The production audit shows NetSuite edits occurred while the link was replenishment, followed by switching it to direct shipping and grouping the SOs. Reconcile on direct-mode conversion and actual group target moves too, so matching PALLET demand in the new group is included.

Grouping's established contract preserves material allocations. Revision: full item reconciliation occurs on NetSuite refresh and direct-mode conversion; group target moves reconcile PALLET packaging only. The group's exact existing material allocation, source row and execution history remain unchanged.

Target moves during refresh raise DIRECT_SHIP_TARGET_CHANGED and must be retried against the current target. Mode/unlink mutation locks use the same target-before-row order as NetSuite refresh to avoid a proven deadlock.

amendments.userRequirement: Both lines of SOA10172 become no yard load required, so it should disappear from the operator screen.
acceptance: Active and planned delivery lists hide a direct-TO order/group when every remaining unloaded pickable quantity is covered by active direct-TO allocations and no yard work, packing or blocked quantities remain.
Grouped SO children must not reappear individually after the completed group is hidden.
Partial or cancelled direct supply, packed stock, blocked allocations and authorized reloads remain discoverable.
Existing PO-only reference discovery is preserved. No order status, loading history, receipts or NetSuite fulfillment is changed by list filtering.

amendments.userClarification: If only direct ship lines are left, filter the whole order. If at least one line needs yard loading, keep the order and show its direct ship lines.
amendments.supersedes: The prior autonomous exception preserving PO-only reference cards; fully linked PO or TO reference lines remain available through order detail but do not create active yard work.
acceptance: Use actual no_yard_load_required projections, rather than a specific linked order type, to decide whether only direct supply remains.
Keep direct reference lines in detail whenever any yard loading remains. Preserve packing, blocked-quantity and authorized-reload work.
